description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee attachments within a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee attachments, with detailed validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing employee attachments, including CRUD operations with validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee attachment based on employee number, screen, and attachment ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all attachments for a specific employee on a specified PIM screen.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and uploads a new attachment for an employee on a specific screen.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates details of an existing employee attachment, including replacing the file if provided.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee attachments based on provided IDs.
